observation.command: su rabbitmq -s /bin/sh -c "rabbitmqctl status 2>&1 | grep -E 'RabbitMQ version|Uptime' | head -3; echo ---queues---; rabbitmqctl list_queues name type durable 2>/dev/null; echo ---policies---; rabbitmqctl list_policies 2>/dev/null; echo ---users---; rabbitmqctl list_users 2>/dev/null"
